reading.title: Solar Cells Inspected on NASA’s NEO Surveyor
reading.summary: Description The large sunshade of NASA’s Near-Earth Object (NEO) Surveyor mission is inspected by a technician at BAE Systems Space & Mission Systems in Boulder, Colorado, in late July. Built by Applied Aerospace in Stockton, California, the sunshade structure was outfitted with its solar cells by SolAero Technologies in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in January. Environmental […]

news.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
news.summary: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.
